releaseNotes: Delete an account you no longer use, from Settings or from Payment Methods. Bank, Cash and UPI can go too - the lock on them was left over from when balances were tracked by name
An account is kept, not deleted, if transactions are still on it or a card or UPI handle still draws on it - and you are told which, by name, instead of just being refused
Your last remaining account can never be deleted, since the money would have nowhere to sit
The update dialog now explains Android's "Harmful app blocked" warning before it appears, and says to tap Install anyway
Installs over the top of 3.6.0 or later
